title: Escape Generator
description: Link generators to doors, lamps and powered blocks — trigger them all at once or chain multi-step cinematics with a custom camera path.
body:
Generator Mod adds a new block — the Generator — that links to doors, lamps, levers, and other powered blocks. Flip the generator on and all linked targets activate instantly. Chain multiple generators to a single target for AND-logic: it only fires when every generator is active.

The Director's Wrench unlocks multi-step cinematics: record a camera path with targets that trigger at each step, building fully scripted sequences — all without command blocks.

Items:
- Generator — the core block
- Circuit Wrench — bind generators to targets
- Director's Wrench — bind generators to targets with cinematic camera steps (creative/give only)
